title: Extract convention rebuild from review.rs into conventions::pipeline
description: Extract the FCA convention pipeline (attribute extraction, effect enrichment, global+per-component FCA rebuild, dedup, convention upsert, history snapshots, stale-convention deletion, lifecycle proposals, drift recording, template generation) from review.rs::build_findings lines 503-715 into conventions::pipeline::rebuild(db, registry, workspace_root). Call from post_parse_sequence so conventions become parse-fresh like every other derived layer. Review keeps only check/check_inverse of changed symbols against persisted model + convention-waiver partition. build_findings drops from ~500 to ~150 lines.
execution_record: Extracted FCA convention pipeline from review.rs::build_findings into conventions::pipeline::rebuild, called from post_parse_sequence. New drift_alerts DB table (migration 0036). Convention drift findings merge into health_findings. build_findings reduced from ~360 to ~254 lines (constraint eval + changed-symbol check/check_inverse + waiver partition remain). All 802 tests pass.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review (adversarial, against 8f2fe19^):

Verdict: needs-attention

1. [high] Zero-symbol rebuild leaves stale conventions persisted (pipeline.rs:106-112) — early return when all_sym_attrs is empty skips delete_stale_conventions, history recording, and orphan template cleanup. Stale conventions persist in DB, review reads them via all_conventions_merged.

2. [high] Convention drift uses stale HRR vectors (pipeline.rs:752-765) — post_parse_sequence calls conventions::pipeline::rebuild before compute_hrr_vectors, but rebuild computes HRR coherence from hrr_vectors table. After a parse that changes symbols, drift is computed against previous parse's vectors.
